errors.text: The proposed carbon-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of intermediate-temperature aging in AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
The initial material is incorrectly treated as a generic single-phase solid solution, whereas the target alloy is an as-cast FCC+B2 eutectic alloy.
No temperatures, exposure times, loading rate, or other quantitative boundaries are defined.
The proposed TRIP-to-TWIP mechanism is unrelated to the target mechanism involving L12 ordering, increased APBE, planar slip, and crack initiation at jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.
The cited evidence supports carbon-enhanced twinning or strength under room-temperature tensile testing, but not toughness preservation after thermal exposure.
The hypothesis predicts only generic toughness preservation and misses the target non-monotonic ductile-brittle-ductile transition.
